paragraphs: Monzo aims to make money work for everyone by understanding how customers actually use their money, a challenge that mirrors my work on XGBoost churn classifier in R (tidymodels) with two-stage Bayesian hyperparameter search, SMOTE inside the recipe and MCC evaluation.
Anomaly detection on 200:1 class-imbalanced data with Isolation Forest and ensemble classifiers, tracked in MLflow.
I am keen to apply these modelling skills to help Monzo uncover real customer behaviours.
